name: @ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp
description: SLICC's CDP layer: client, browser API, transports, HAR, and ARIA snapshot

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32-wasip1 -p slicc-cdp -p curlwright && mkdir -p bin && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/playwright-cli.wasm bin/playwright-cli.wasm && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/curlwright.wasm bin/curlwright.wasm
scripts.typecheck: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/cdp-client.js && node --check src/connect.js && node --check src/page.js && node --check src/browser.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check packages/sliccy-browser/src/browser.js && node --check packages/sliccy-browser/src/fetch-script.js
scripts.test:integration: export SLICC_CDP_PORTS="${SLICC_CDP_PORTS:-9300-9309}" && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --workspace && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build -p slicc-cdp -p curlwright && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 -p slicc-cdp -p curlwright && npm run -s browser >/dev/null && node scripts/test-integration.mjs test/integration/*.test.mjs
